method.download: curl -L --fail; official PDF links read from the saved IPA index HTML.
method.pageSelection: Located Question 1 by rendering PDF pages. Question 1 is PDF pages 6–10, matching printed page numbers 6–10.
method.render: PyMuPDF 1.26.6 / MuPDF 1.26.11, get_pixmap(matrix=fitz.Matrix(2,2)); full page, opaque RGB PNG. Question PDF has no text layer.
method.read: Author opened question-p06.png through question-p10.png with view_image and read their content. Author also opened official-ans-p01.png and official-cmnt-p01.png. Initial 1x locator images were removed after page identification.
method.transcription: Manual transcription from rendered page images. Paragraphs replace paper-width line breaks. ++...++ preserves underlining; [a/b/c] blanks use full-width brackets. Figure 1 is retained as a pixel crop. Table 1 and Table 2 are transcribed as Markdown tables. No third-party explanation was consulted.
method.figureCrop: Pillow crop of the already rendered question-p06.png; rectangle [102,1004,976,1360] in rendered pixels, includes figure, FW note and caption.
method.answers: Read official IPA answer-example PDF page 1 image. Preserve all listed examples; typography spaces around Latin characters/digits are removed. Only official examples are registered, with no authored alternative accepted answers.
method.rubric: Each field has 2–3 independently authored learning points, informed by question conditions and official answer/commentary. These are not official partial-credit criteria.
method.review: No independent review performed or review record created by this author. Awaiting parent /root independent source review.

authorNotes: Question 1 has 6 items and 8 fields: 1 + 2 + 2 + 1 + 1 + 1. Question 4 is split into (1) and (2) items.
Short term/setting/choice fields use exactText. All explanation sentences use self; no keyword or similarity-based automatic marking is provided.
No full mock exam was created. This is one official-question draft for a self-evaluation pilot.

body.md and body in case.json cover the entire common passage. sourceImages keep every original paragraph, diagram, table, condition and item prompt; image fidelity remains available even if Markdown layout differs.
Network figure alt text is an accessibility description, not a substitute for the faithful source figure.
case.json, blind.json and sourceEvidence.json are drafts, not publication/review authorization.
